// diagnostic E-SUBJECT-CALL-ARITY

Jet.MemberShorthandArity

A bare member chain cannot supply a {arity}-parameter callable here

What

A bare member chain cannot supply a {arity}-parameter callable here

Why

Lower-case `.member` shorthand supplies exactly one subject; a callable with {arity} parameters needs all parameters named

Fix

Write the full lambda, for example `fn(first, second) { first{chain} }`

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.MemberShorthandArity: Tests/UI/bare_member_callable_arity.stderr.

Error: Jet.MemberShorthandArity: A bare member chain cannot supply a 2-parameter callable here
  --> Tests/UI/bare_member_callable_arity.jet:3:24
    |
  3 |     _: orders.fold(0, .something)
    |                        ^^^^^^^^^
 Why: Lower-case `.member` shorthand supplies exactly one subject; a callable with 2 parameters needs all parameters named
 Fix: Write the full lambda, for example `fn(first, second) { first.something }`
